points.description: States that strings declared as character arrays have a null character ('\0', null terminator/element) added at the end of the array (whereas the string type does not require/show this).
points.partial_credit: Half or more if the student mentions a terminating/end marker for char arrays but is vague or does not name it as null/'\0'.

points.description: Identifies that the null element is at the end of the character array (the terminator marks the end of the string), i.e. it takes up an extra element.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying character-array strings end with an added null character ('\0'), in any wording, even briefly. Part marks for vague mentions of an end marker or extra element without naming null. No marks for differences not about the null terminator (e.g. only that string is a class or easier to use).
